title: vprlab external leak-monitor policy
description: Shape mirror for tools/leak-lab/policy.py. The Python loader is the binding validator: it also rejects duplicate JSON keys, duplicate labels/endpoints, a positive-control endpoint that differs from gateway_ipv4 or overlaps an allowed flow, non-unicast addresses/MACs, non-public destination addresses, well-known service ports, a gateway_mac equal to vm_wan_mac, and a gateway other than the plan's fixed 10.250.0.1.

vm_wan_mac.description: Unicast, non-zero MAC; the fixed lab VM WAN address is 52:54:00:76:70:02.

gateway_ipv4.description: Must be exactly 10.250.0.1, the bridge address the host plan configures; must differ from vm_wan_ipv4.

gateway_mac.description: Required always. The plan sets the host bridge MAC to exactly 52:54:00:76:70:01. Gateway-to-VM ARP and inbound tunnel evidence are allowed only from this MAC. Must be unicast, non-zero and different from vm_wan_mac.

dst_ipv4.description: A public unicast address. RFC1918, CGNAT/Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10, 192.0.0.0/24, 192.0.2.0/24, 198.18.0.0/15, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24, loopback, link-local, multicast and reserved space are rejected by the binding Python loader.

dst_port.description: DNS, DoT, NTP, mDNS and LLMNR ports are rejected: an allowed relay flow must never whitelist a plaintext service leak.

ipv4.description: Dotted-quad IPv4 literal only; hostnames and leading-zero octets are rejected.

unicast_ipv4.description: Additionally rejects 0.0.0.0/8, 127/8, 224/4, 240/4 and 169.254/16; the Python loader is binding.

lab_host.description: A usable host address inside 10.250.0.0/24; the Python loader is binding.
